readout_other: Visually observed evoked muscle movements (tail, hindlimb, forelimb)
direction_notes: Axicon-lens tFUS of the mouse motor cortex evoked movement in a specific body segment (tail at the mapped site); US intensity was raised until a movement threshold was seen.
safety_notes: Normal behaviour observed in all animals after sonication; intensity stated to be below FDA imaging limits.

exposures.label: Axicon-lens tFUS of mouse motor cortex

target.label: motor cortex (area related to the control of tail motility)

device.manufacturer: Prototype built in-house with a Steminc piezo-disc element
device.model: tFUS-axicon transducer, 445 kHz, epoxy/PDMS axicon lens

timing.protocol_description: Motor cortex stimulated every 3 s with a train of low-intensity tFUS pulses (PD 0.36 ms, PRF 1 kHz); intensity was gradually increased at each site until movement was detected. Number of pulses per train (stimulus duration) not stated.

source_quotes.n_subjects: To conduct tFUS stimulation of intact motor cortex, CF-1 mice (n ¼ 3) were anesthetized with ketamine (80 mg/kg i.p.)/Xylazine (10 mg/kg i.p.).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A prototype tFUS-axicon transducer operating at a frequency of 445 kHz was fabricated.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: For sonication parameters, pulse duration (PD) of 0.36 ms and PRF of 1 kHz were used.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: For sonication parameters, pulse duration (PD) of 0.36 ms and PRF of 1 kHz were used.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: Our findings support that low-intensity sonication with a small peak pressure amplitude (0.1 MPa) does not cause the bloodbrain barrier to be disrupted or cavitation.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: A prototype tFUS-axicon transducer was built following the specifications summarized in Table 2.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: A prototype tFUS-axicon transducer was built following the specifications summarized in Table 2.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.ispta_w_cm2: The motor cortex of mice was stimulated every 3 s with a low-intensity train of tFUS pulses having a spatial peak temporal average intensity (Ispta) of 36 $\mathrm { m W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 }$ .

flags.reason: 36 mW/cm2 converted to 0.036 W/cm2; domain not stated (radiant-force power meter; skull effect ignored); also used for mapping at threshold, so may not apply to all conditions.
0.1 MPa given as 'small peak pressure amplitude' in the discussion; domain not stated and not obviously consistent with 36 mW/cm2 Ispta.
Stimulus duration and number of pulses are not given.
Transducer built in-house; manufacturer field describes the build, piezo element from Steminc.
